name: std/math

Shortreal -> FoxArrayBase (std/compiler): low-level float-array coupling. RESOLUTION: move Shortreal out to a compiler-adjacent package, or drop from core math.
MathMitLef -> CalcGauss (std/calc): Mittag-Leffler needs Gauss quadrature. RESOLUTION: split MathMitLef into std/math-special (tier 2, may depend on std/calc).
MathInt -> Random (std/math or util): Random imports Math32, so Random belongs in this package; fold in.
